sources.title: yolos-tiny: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: As a tiny model, it likely requires less than 2GB for single-image inference, but batch processing requirements depend on image resolution and batch size. Q: How does accuracy compare to the base YOLOS model? A: The tiny variant achieves 28.7 AP on COCO validation while the base model achieves 42 AP—a significant accuracy gap.
